RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.5.0 • Static /MT Win32 C++20 • .CHM & WinHelp .HLP Rescue

Context Help That Actually Wakes Up on F1 — Plus Turnkey .CHM & .HLP Rescue.

Millions of desktop, CAD, laboratory, and industrial Windows applications still depend on 1990s Compiled HTML Help (.chm — blocked over network shares under Mark-of-the-Web) or classic WinHelp (.hlp + .cnt — completely removed from Windows 10 and 11). RaggieSoft Help Studio (v0.5.0) is a 100% zero-dependency static /MT Win32 C++20 suite (HelpStudio.exe, rshbuild.exe, & RaggieSoftHelp.exe) that opens and decompiles raw .chm, .hhp, .hlp, .cnt, and Word footnote .rtf archives, scrubs legacy Word MsoNormal inline black styles, and compiles modular .rshm packs, single-EXE LZMS viewers, static web portals, and VPAT 2.5!

Open Compiled Help Studio Web Manual → View Auto-Generated VPAT 2.5 .rshp Grammar (llms-full.txt) Download Installer Studio (Includes RaggieSoftHelp.exe)
100% Zero-Dependency Static /MT Win32 C++20 Across x64 & ARM64

Four Core Capabilities of RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.5.0

1. Raw .CHM (ITSF/LZX) & WinHelp .HLP/.CNT Decompilers

Decompiles binary .chm (LZX streams + #IVB context IDs), .hhp/.hhc/.hhk, AND bricked 1990s .hlp (3F 5F 03 00 B+ tree + LZ77) + .cnt / Word footnote .rtf archives—scrubbing Microsoft Word MsoNormal & FrontPage color:black soup automatically!

2. Modular .rshm Pack, Single-EXE LZMS Viewer & Direct Rescue Mode

Ship shared module.rshm.json packs, stamp a single-file LZMS-compressed <YourProduct>Help.exe (zero loose files, UNC-share safe!), OR double-click raw .chm and .hlp files directly in RaggieSoftHelp.exe on Windows 11!

3. Sub-5ms Named Pipe F1 Routing & Drop-In SDKs

Auto-emits RaggieSoftHelpSdk.hpp (1-line WM_HELP & HtmlHelpCompatW C++ shims), RaggieSoftHelpSdk.cs (.NET), RaggieSoftHelp.bas (Classic Visual Basic 6!), and TypeScript constants.

4. Single-Source Offline Help + Static SEO Web Portal + VPAT 2.5

Every .rshp build compiles offline desktop help, static WCAG 2.2 AA web documentation pages (with instant search & llms.txt), and a procurement-ready HTML5 VPAT 2.5 conformance report from one set of chapters.
